value.rationale: Generalized covering radius measures the number of jointly corrupted/queried coordinates in block metric. The complete hierarchy for a natural repeated projective code is not a numerical curiosity: it gives an exact integer phase law for every repetition and every query order, a matching construction based on index-two separation, the first order at which the full redundancy is attained, and the asymptotic fraction 1-2^{-t}. This is a natural exact infinite-family classification, without asserting a downstream breakthrough or improvement for arbitrary codes.
